name: Pagination
description: Desktop-only numbered pagination extracted from SearchResultsPage. Controlled callbacks or native links, localized page names, neutral selection and separate blue keyboard focus.

figma.notes: Derived from the maintained SearchResultsPage desktop pagination; no independently verified Figma component mapping.

page.description: Current page, 1-based. Clamped to the available range.

pageCount.description: Non-negative integer total page count. Zero renders nothing.

onPageChange.description: Host updates results and the controlled page. Mutually exclusive with getPageHref.

getPageHref.description: Return a real destination for native navigation. Mutually exclusive with onPageChange.

focus.note: 2px blue outline, 2px offset, 4px list gutter; default and inverse focus aliases.

disabled.note: Disabled non-current controls use semantic disabled text tokens; the current page retains its selected fill and contrasting text. All disabled controls remain non-interactive; no opacity.

tapTarget.note: PC-only 32px controls match the existing search page. Hidden below 1024px; no native touch minimum claim.

accessibility.ariaPattern: Native navigation, aria-current=page when the current page is visible; ellipsis hidden.
accessibility.notes: Fixed first nine pages, one ellipsis and last page; no middle expansion or previous/next controls. Up to ten pages render in full. A collapsed current page has no visible current marker. Disabled link controls render static spans with aria-disabled. No initial focus or arrow-key tab behavior.

testing.rationale: Storybook verifies controlled page changes; browser coverage checks numbered-only controls, link semantics, keyboard focus, themes and mobile hiding.
